Tower-defense game in a child's bedroom at night, one fixed three-quarter camera looking down about 40 degrees at a wooden floor with a faint tile grid; walls, wardrobe, bed and fort share one perspective. Center: a patchwork quilt fort draped over chairs, soft sagging folds and stitched seams, red flag, warm fairy lights, an amber-lit arched opening with a child silhouette; a lower dark-blue star blanket extends from its right side. Six lavender pillows form walls bending two dotted crayon paths: violet from a half-open wardrobe (red eyes inside), teal from the dark gap under a star-quilt bed. A plush teddy bear blocks a squashed purple scribble monster; a blue flashlight on books beams up the teal path, erasing a crayon monster into wax crumbs. A translucent green toy soldier is being placed, its radius-3 tile diamond highlighted yellow. Taped paper HUD: '이불 요새', '셋째 밤', '새벽 2:14', '요새 튼튼함 4/5', '엄마 의심 1/3', '다음 순찰 2:19~2:22', '털뭉치 ×3 4초', '키다리 ×1 9초'. Tooltip: '옷장 길 6칸', '끄러 가기 1.2초'. Bottom tray, exactly four toy cards: 곰인형 2, 손전등 3, 장난감 병정 2 (selected), 오르골 4; candy 7. Painterly storybook, indigo night, warm amber fort light. Correction: the yellow placement preview is a full Manhattan-distance radius-3 diamond (25 floor tiles: 1-3-5-7-5-3-1 rows) centered on the soldier, clearly overlapping six tiles of the violet wardrobe path.
